Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC scope, success criteria, timeline, and next steps so we can lock the kickoff.

High-level recap / success criteria (proposed):
- Integrate Redwood inference API with Acme's staging environment for the targeted feature (document summarization)
- Achieve average generation latency <= 450ms for 1k-token prompts under expected load (10 concurrent users)
- Maintain summary quality: >85% acceptance rate on a 50-sample blind eval against your rubric
- No production data exfiltration; audit logging enabled for all inference calls

Evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (prep): data access, credential provisioning, and baseline tests
- Week 1 (kickoff + integration): initial integration with sample dataset, smoke tests
- Week 2-3 (tuning & validation): iterate on prompts and quantization/profile settings; run blind eval set
- Week 4 (readout): final results, handoff, and recommended next steps (rollout plan / Dedicated proposal if needed)

Proposed timeline & milestones (tentative):
- Kickoff: week of Mar 16 — 60-90m call to align scope and owners
- Weekly check-ins: Tue 30m standups (progress, blockers) starting Mar 17
- Mid-point review: Mar 30 (30m)
- Final readout: Apr 9 (45m)

Ownership (please confirm):
- Acme POC lead: Sam Johnson (integration + acceptance)
- Acme data owner: Priya Rao (access & dataset sign-off)
- Redwood AE / overall: Marissa Cole
- Redwood SE / technical lead: Rishi Malhotra
- Redwood CS: Olga Petrov (onboarding & success metrics)

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), Acme_Eval_Criteria.xlsx (proposed rubric), redwood_poc_checklist.docx

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the success criteria and owners above
2) Confirm possible kickoff slots for week of Mar 16 (we can propose a calendar invite once confirmed)
3) Share any required sample data or access instructions (S3 credentials, IP allowlist) by EOD Mar 15 if possible

If that looks good I'll send the kickoff invite and upload the final SOW to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks,
